sentences.en: Thay maun laund on the mukkil Craig an see gin thay coud finnd a wey inti the keep.
sentences.vi: Thay maun wash on the mukkil Craig an see gin thay coud finnd a wey inti the keep.

sentences.en: Say what ye like, I maun say what I believe.
sentences.vi: Nói những gì bạn thích, tôi nói những gì tôi tin.

sentences.en: Big an braw thay maun be, for ti luik weill on a heich bodie lyke masell.
sentences.vi: Big an braw thay maun be, for ti luik weill on a heich bodie lyke masell.

sentences.en: He aye hae mair men ti help him, an finnd the bairn thay wad, tho thay maun hunt the warld.
sentences.vi: He aye hae mair men ti giup anh ta, an finnd the bairn thay wad, tho thay maun săn warld.
